title: Category Theory Explained
description: A self-contained guide that uses category theory as a lens to make the structure and logic of Madhyasth Darshan precise — plain-language ideas first, then the formal theory — and shows where the notation stops

title: The Coexistence Template
description: The single structural template beneath Madhyasth Darshan — saturated units recognising and fulfilling relationships, exchanging value, composing into assemblies, and transmitting their method — stated formally for all four orders and usable to design or diagnose any assembly

title: Restfulness and Least Action: A Category-Theoretic Comparison
description: Whether restfulness (vishram) in Madhyasth Darshan structurally mirrors the Principle of Least Action — mapped through category-theoretic functors, forgetful reduction, and colimits.

title: Coexistence from First Principles
description: A generative re-founding of the coexistence template: three kernel primitives - satta, triadic activity, and saturation - from which units, relationships, values, composition, and transmission are constructed, with a recovery audit against The Coexistence Template as the adequacy criterion
